༄༅/ /shes rab ky-i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po nyi shu lnga pa skad gnyis shan sbyar ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// shes rab ky-i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po nyi shu lnga pa skad gnyis shan sbyar ba bzhugs so//

rgya gar skad du/ bha ga wa tī pradzñā pā ra mi tā hṛ da ya/ bod skad du/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po/ na mo bha ga wa tī pradzñā pā ra mi tā ye/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// e waṃ asmin shrā wa ye ka wa ye le/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bha ga wa te rā dza gṛha gṛdha kū ṭa parba te/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal po'i khab/ bya rgod phung po'i ri na/ bhikṣu ma hā saṃgha/ dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang*/ bo dhi satwa ma hā saṃgha sattaṃ tiṣṭha tiḥ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang thabs cig tu bzhugs so// ten kā len bha ga wa te gaṃ bhīr wā bha nā ma dharma parya ya sya sa mā dhi sa ma ni khi shi wān/྄ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so// ten kha lu su no bo dhi satwa ma hā satwa dhyā wa lo ki te shwa ra tsa pā ra mi tā gaṃ bhīr tsyai'ar dṛṣṭa pañtsa skandha sa yis pra krita shū n+yaṃ bi dṛṣṭa/ a tha buddha nu bhā wen/ a yu ṣyaṃ shā ri pu tre ṇa/ yang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo'i spyod pa nyid la rnam par lta zhing*/ bo dhi satwa ma hā satwa syā wa lo ki te shwa raṃ e waṃ mokta/ go tra pu tra kul di ru ka yaṃ/ ya katya pradzñā pā ra mi tā gaṃ bhīr tsaryā tsā ṇaṃ kā ma te/ ya thā shakṣa ka ro mi/ e waṃ na mo kāksha tsa/ bo dhi satwa ma hā satwa syā wa lo ki te shwa re ṇa a yuṣyaṃ shā ri pu traṃ e waṃ nā mo3/ phung po lnga po de dag la yang rang bzhin gyis stong par rnam par lta'o// de nas sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so// rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo'i spyod pa spyad par 'dod pa des ji ltar bslab par bya/ de skad ces smras pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras shā ri pu tra go tra go tra ku la dā ri kā ya ye katya pradzñā pā ra mi tā gaṃ bhī ra tsaryā tsā ri ṇa kā ma te/ ta thā hi dṛṣṭa ka ro mi ti/ pañtsa skandhe pa ya sa pra kri ten shū n+ya samyakā nu dṛṣṭaḥ rū pa shū n+yāṃ/ shū n+yā ta rū pya/ rū pā ta/ pi shū n+yā tā n+ya thā/ shū n+yā t ta pi rū pā n+ya thā/ ta thā na saṃdzñā saṃskā ra/ gzigs dbang phyug gis tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu la 'di skad ces smras so// shā ri bu rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zab mo spyod pa spyad par 'dod pa des 'di ltar rnam par blta ba bya ste phung po lnga po de dag kyang rang bzhin gyi stong par yang dag par rjes su blta'o/ */ gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so// bi dzñā nā ni shū n+yā ta/ shā ri pu tra tasmatta dhi sarba dharma shū n+yā ta/ a lakṣa ṇa/ a nutpanna/ ni rū ddha/ a ma la/ a bi ma la/ no ū na no pūrṇa ka/ shā ri pu tra tasmatta rhi shū n+yātaṃ/ a rū pa/ a be da na/ a saṃskā ra/ a bi dzñā na/ a nai tra/ a shro tra/ a nā sa/ gzugs las stong pa nyid gzhan ma yin stong pa nyid las kyang gzugs gzhan ma yin no/ */ de bzhin du/ tshor ba dang*/ 'du shes dang*/ 'du byed dang*/ rnam par shes pa rnams stong pa'o// shā ri'i bu/ de ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid de/ mtshan nyid med pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma 'gags pa/ dri ma med pa/ dri ma dang bral ba med pa/ bri ba med cing*/ gang ba med pa'o// a dzi hwa/

a kā ya/ a ma na/ a rū pa/ a shapad/ a gandha/ a ra sa/ a sparsha/ a dharma/ a nai tra dhā tu/ a ma na dhā tu/ a ma na sya bi dzñā na dhā tu ma dhyā si/ nir bidyā/ nir bidyā kṣa ya/ a dza ra ma ṇaṃ/ a dza ra ma ṇaṃ kṣa ya ma dhyā sa/ e waṃ duḥkha sa mu da ya/ shā ri'i bu/ de lta bas na/ stong pa nyid la gzugs med/ tshor ba med/ 'du shes med/ 'du byed rnams med/ rnam par shes pa med/ mig med/ rna ba med/ sna med/ lce med/ lus med/ yid med/ gzugs med/ sgra med/ dri med/ ro med/ reg bya/ chos med do// mig gi khams med pa nas yid kyi khams med/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi bar du yang med do// ma ni ro dha/ a mārga/ a dzñā na/ a prapta/ a prapta santi/ shā ri pu tra tasma dda dhi bo dhi satwa nāṃ kra dra snyā na tasmi ta pradzñā pā ra mi te yaṃ bha go ni ke taḥ tsittaṃ no ā warṇaṃ.a to traṃ/ kimpi lā kā yatpa wā ra tiḥ nirwā ṇaṃ naṣṭhi ga taḥ ṭi ka la ka ti byā si n+ya sarba buddha bhu yo pradzñā pā ra mitā/ ma rig pa med/ ma rig pa zad pa med pa nas rga shi med/ rga shi zad pa'i bar du yang med do// de bzhin du/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ kun 'byung ba dang*/ 'gog pa dang*/ lam med/ ye shes med/ thob pa med/ ma thob pa yang med/ shā ri'i bu/ de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni thob pa med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la brten cing gnas te/ te ha bha wa ྅ nu tta ra samyaksaṃ pūrṇa/ bodhya bhi saṃ pūrṇa bhya ddhaḥ tasmatta dha pradzñā pā ra mi tā mant+ra/ ma hā bidyā mant+ra/ a nuttar mant+ra/ a sa ma sa ma ka ra mant+ra/ sarba duḥkha pra shānta ka ra mant+ra/ no mṛ ṣa sma ta satyaka dzñāro mi te/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā sya mant+ra uktaṃ/ tadya thā/ oṃ ga te ga te pā ra ga te sems la sgrib pa med pas skrag pa med de/ phyin ci log las shin tu 'das nas/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i mthar phyin to// dus gsum du rnam par bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la brten nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i bya chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so// de lta bas na/

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags/ rig pa pā ra saṃ ga te bo dhi swā hā/ shā ri pu tra bo dhi satwa ma hā satwenaiwaṃ hi pradzñā pā ra mi tā gaṃ bhī ra shakṣa ka ra ṇaḥ a tha bha ga wān sa mā dhi ta yo tarthir te/ bo dhi satwa ma hā satwa rya lo ke shwa raṃ sā dhu ka ra ma hā ta/ sā dhu sā dhu go tra pu tra te te thā te ta thā ta/ ya thā twa yo da sha nai waṃ/ pradzñā pā ra mi tā gaṃ bhī raṃ/ chen po'i sngags/ bla na med pa'i sngags/ mi mnyam pa dang mnyam par byed pa'i sngags/ sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i sngags/ mi brdzun pas na bden par shes par bya ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sngags smras pa/ 'di lta ste/ 'dud do gshegs ma gshegs ma pha rol tu gshegs ma yang dag par gshegs ma byang chub tu gzhi tshugs/ shā ri'i bu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu tsaryā ka ro mi te/ ta thā ga ta ya si a nu pra tya yi teḥ bha ga wānai wāṃ na mant+ra ya te sa ma/ a yu ṣyaṃ shā ri pu tra bo dhi satwa ma hā satwaryā wa lo ki te shwa ra/ sarba bā na raṃ sarṣatta yau de wa nar a su ra sa gandharba sya lo ka pra tya yi te/ bha ga wān bho ṣi ten bha st+wa tradaḥ ārya pañtsa bingsha ti pradzñā pā ra mi tā syaṃḥ phyin pa zab mo la bslab par bya'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ legs so legs so// rigs kyi bu de de bzhin no// de de bzhin te/ ji ltar khyod kyis bstan pa de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyad par bya ste/ garbha samyaksa mapta/ pradzñā garbha bho ṭa sya tu tta pā saṃskṛ ta sya tu tā ya tsa mā ri ra tri ka dwi bha ṣi dharma kīrtenā brtiḥ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyang rjes su yi rang ngo*// bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/

tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bu dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang*/ lha dang*/ mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// bcom ldan 'das kyi 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po nyi shu lnga pa yang dag par rdzogs so// shes rab snying po bod kyi skad la legs par sbyar ba 'di/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad du 'bri gung pa skad gnyis smra ba chos kyi grags pas bsgyur ba'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// shes rab snying po shan sbyar 'di'i ma dpe dbu med bris rnying la song*/ ma gsal ba dang sngags yig brtsegs ma rnams ji bzhin rtogs dka' bar brten/ nor 'khrul mchis rigs la slad zhib 'jug gnang bar rigs so// //
